Role Summary And Impact

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Digital team, supporting process improvement, project automation, and technology solutions. Working with the team lead, you will drive data analysis initiatives, design database structures, automate workflows, and apply ETL techniques to turn complex data into information that supports effective decision-making.

This role combines data analysis, database design, artificial intelligence, and project coordination, with opportunities to contribute throughout the project lifecycle—from planning and execution to monitoring and closure.

In this role, you will:

  • Apply artificial intelligence tools and techniques to support data standardization.
  • Design and maintain efficient, scalable database resources to support data processing and analysis.
  • Lead process automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency.
  • Improve and systematize workflows to optimize project and product delivery.
  • Apply ETL techniques to extract, transform, and load data for advanced analysis.
  • Plan, execute, monitor, and close projects, coordinating activities to ensure effective delivery.
  • Investigate and resolve complex technical problems accurately and promptly.
  • Lead the analysis of large datasets to uncover actionable insights.
  • Oversee automated report generation to improve access to information and support decision-making.
